parsed.name: 整数编号任务规则
parsed.description: 这是一个用于集群计算工作流的规则对象，而非物理实验设备。它按整数任务编号生成、发布和跟踪任务，常用于显微成像数据分析或配方型数据处理流程中的任务调度、完成状态管理与超时重试控制。
parsed.description_en: This is a software workflow rule object rather than a physical laboratory device. It generates, releases, and tracks tasks indexed by integer IDs, and is used in cluster-based microscopy data analysis or recipe-style processing workflows for task scheduling, completion tracking, and timeout/retry handling.

actions.description: 标记该规则的任务释放已完成，并可定义最终任务数量。
actions.description_en: Mark task release for this rule as complete, and optionally define the final number of tasks.

actions.description: 将指定编号范围内的任务设为可用。
actions.description_en: Make a specified range of task IDs available.

actions.description: 对可分配任务发起竞标并返回匹配的任务。
actions.description_en: Submit a bid for available tasks and return any matched tasks.

actions.description: 标记一组任务为已完成或失败。
actions.description_en: Mark a set of tasks as completed or failed.

actions.description: 将该规则设为非活动状态，使其不再发布任务广告。
actions.description_en: Set the rule inactive so it no longer advertises tasks.

actions.description: 获取该规则的任务数量与运行状态信息。
actions.description_en: Get task counts and runtime status information for this rule.

actions.description: 轮询任务超时状态并更新相关记录。
actions.description_en: Poll for task timeouts and update related status records.
